selection: Require natural and authored validation top1 and top5 counts each >= current baseline; maximize mean of their MRR, tie lower strength. Zero-strength baseline is a candidate.
guards: Selected model must retain completion16 first choices, daily32 aggregate top1/top5, and old600 aggregate top1/top5 versus current baseline; otherwise retain baseline production and report experimental model.
evaluation: Freeze selection before running reused natural200 and authored120 regression; these and all old regression sets are not fresh blind tests.
release: No APK/version bump in this task. Existing major release gate still applies.
refinement: Exact lexical-only relations failed to improve validation MRR at every nonzero strength; no held-out/regression results inspected. Add shared training-only coarse POS and first/last-word anchors, compiled over training relation surfaces; repeat the same strength grid and selection/guard rules.
